description: This file defines the EditorManager class and React hooks for managing editor state, configuration, and toolbar settings in the Notesnook project.

classes.name: EditorManager
classes.description: Manages multiple editor instances, their configurations, and toolbar settings, extending a base store for state management.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Retrieves the editor context for a given ID.

methods.name: setEditor
methods.description: Sets or removes an editor context for a given ID.

methods.name: updateEditor
methods.description: Updates the editor context for a given ID with partial data or a function.
